study.question: Does resolving within-bucket recency in the appended grouped-history readout improve validation utility beyond the strongest frozen source best and incumbent, and is any gain specifically larger for target queries?
study.hypothesis: Observed source limitation: incumbent _represent and _encode replace ages with floor(log2(age+1))+1 and _histogram uses four broad bins. For otherwise equal histories, changing age3000s to3500s preserves every incumbent feature. This is a structural collision, not evidence that precise timing predicts clicks. Interpolating adjacent already-allocated recency embeddings can expose within-bucket timing to retrieval without changing original grouped features, representation width, norm reference or capacity. Finer timing may help target-conditioned relevance; alternatively hard buckets may denoise timestamps or interpolation may help context equally. Recent exact-key multiplicity correction lost AUC despite working diagnostics: distinct_target0.6201503520 versus event_target0.6202303849; context0.6198864799 versus0.6200080603. Its target logloss0.195760538 improved over0.195808211 despite lower AUC. This is not a global refutation of repetition handling and is not a reason to pursue it without a new contrast.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit entire accepted architecture and original norm reference; replace only appended path hard recency lookup by parameter-free linear interpolation. Rounds8-16 changed norms, group priors, slots, interactions, floors, centering, coupled identity or duplicate measure; none in the supplied trajectory changed within-log-bucket timing resolution.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-conditioned local activation inspiration, embeddings and shallow prediction. This is a field-adapted grouped, normalized readout; DIN lines272-277 intentionally avoid softmax to retain intensity. Neither exact DIN reproduction nor invention of interpolation is claimed. Originality of the combination is unverified; registry time/temporal searches found no indexed nearest temporal paper, which is a retrieval limitation, not novelty evidence.

Author README confirms category/brand/action histories have no item ID. Use available ages and fields only; no item embedding, matching supervision or full-paper mechanism claim. Publisher full text is unavailable.

study.proposed_difference: Let x=log2(max(age,0)+1), i=clamp(floor(x)+1,1,32), f=frac(x) with f=0 when i=32. Linear retrieval recency is (1-f)E[i]+fE[min(i+1,32)]; step is E[i]. Both are computed in every cell, but only the selected representation enters retrieval scorer keys and common action/recency values. Original _represent, histogram and pooled norm reference continue using E[i]. No new weights, width, events, older history, auxiliary losses, query generation or optimizer changes. Four cells isolate representation effects under both query sources; no separate key-only/value-only claim.
predictions: Source/algebra: 3000s and3500s collide in incumbent age index12 and histogram bin0; interpolation coefficients differ and can change readout direction with fixed pooled norm. This need not hold for degenerate learned vectors.

Source/algebra: interpolation agrees exactly with step at integer log-age knots, stays continuous in log age before clamping, is a convex combination, and saturates at E32. Only appended path is smoothed; full-model continuity is expressly not predicted.

Host first512 diagnostics: supported within-cell age perturbations preserve original feature block and norm reference; step readout/logits should be invariant up to numeric tolerance, while linear summaries may change. Masked, empty, zero-length and permuted histories preserve inherited invariants.

Primary empirical prediction: linear_target validation AUC exceeds step_target0.6202303848951921 and both source bests0.6191087654101018/0.6153351063827704 at identical training recipe; measure logloss and cost separately.
Conditioning prediction: (AUClinear_target-AUClinear_context)-(AUCstep_target-AUCstep_context)>0 with direction retained under paired seeds43/44; one exploratory seed is insufficient.
falsifiers: Host failure, nonfinite logits/diagnostics, violated original-feature/norm/mask invariants or changed parameter allocation invalidates the implementation before interpreting utility.
Step controls fail to reproduce incumbent target/context behavior within expected numeric tolerance; inspect source/initialization before attribution rather than changing protocol.
Linear_target AUC does not exceed step_target: this implementation does not establish incremental utility, even if logloss or sensitivity improves.
Linear_context matches/exceeds the linear-target improvement, or repetitions reverse interaction sign: no specific benefit to target-conditioned readout.
Cost increase places candidate off observed quality-cost frontier: no efficiency improvement claim.
No within-bin summary response with nondegenerate trained vectors and perturbable inputs undermines the proposed retained-timing mechanism; response alone cannot confirm useful timing.
alternative_explanations: Interpolation changes both scorer keys and readout values; this suite tests the combined recency representation, not their individual contributions.
Interpolation introduces adjacent-embedding parameter sharing and an age smoothness prior as well as finer timing; a positive outcome would not isolate information resolution from regularization.
Same recipe and parameter counts do not imply equal compute or equal optimization behavior; compare host measured cost.
Single-seed validation with many preceding adaptive comparisons remains exploratory; deterministic seed42 replay is not independent repetition.
Hard buckets may be a beneficial noise filter; exact time may be noisy due publisher timestamps or truncation.
Finer time representation may regularize adjacent embeddings rather than exploit true timing.
Original histogram thresholds remain coarse; any success is incremental to the preserved representation, not recovery of missing item identity.
Candidate-supplied first512 diagnostics are not population statistics, independent mechanism proof or a substitute for paired user-cluster uncertainty.
Earlier round6 context beat target while round7 target beat context; both directions and all negative branches remain part of interpretation.
